template: zscore(winsorize(add(trade_when(greater(divide(subtract(vec_avg({unadjustedgrossamt}), vec_avg({adjustedgrossamt})), nan_out(vec_avg({unadjustedgrossamt}), 0.0001)), 0), ts_delta(divide(subtract(vec_avg({unadjustedgrossamt}), vec_avg({adjustedgrossamt})), nan_out(vec_avg({unadjustedgrossamt}), 0.0001)), 5), 0), trade_when(less(divide(subtract(vec_avg({unadjustedgrossamt}), vec_avg({adjustedgrossamt})), nan_out(vec_avg({unadjustedgrossamt}), 0.0001)), 0), multiply(ts_delta(divide(subtract(vec_avg({unadjustedgrossamt}), vec_avg({adjustedgrossamt})), nan_out(vec_avg({unadjustedgrossamt}), 0.0001)), 5), -1), 0)), 4))
idea: **分方向动量加速 (Directional Momentum Split)**：将拆分（正调整比例）与并股/反向拆分（负调整比例）视为不同制度；对正区域取`ts_delta`捕捉“拆分力度加速”，对负区域取负的`ts_delta`捕捉“并股力度加速”；通过`trade_when`分离处理后相加，构造出无论方向如何、只要公司行为冲击在加剧就产生同向信号的非对称动量因子。
